newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: SM Prime up 2.98 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: SM Prime up 2.98 pct in late trade.

text.p: Leading shopping mall developer SM Prime Holdings Inc rose by two centavos, or 2.98 percent, to 6.9 pesos in late trade on Thursday on bargain-hunting and expectations of higher earnings, traders said.
"It is one of the favourites of foreign funds," said Alexis Cabel, analyst at Angping & Associates.
SM Prime was the second most actively traded stock on turnover of 64.54 million pesos.
The stock market's main index rose 13.31 points to 2,552.28 in late trading.

SM Prime earlier said it was opening two new shopping malls each year over the next five years. It will open one mall in July in Manila's Quezon district and another in Cavite province, south of the capital.
"One mall translates to about a 20 percent increase in its income for the year," said Cilette Liboro, research head at Orion-Squire Capital.
